messages:
alex: heads up — support ticket: customer saw duplicate token charges when a stream fell back to a smaller model and a toolcall got truncated. repro attached a few logs.
alex: repro summary: start streaming -> primary route overloaded -> fallback to model-small -> toolcall invoked -> toolcall truncated mid-response -> client reconnects -> billing reflects both the original prefix and the fallback prefix charged.
morgan: any trace IDs?
alex: logs snippet: ```INFO route=primary session=abc123 tokens_prelim=38 at=2026-02-18T12:01:02Z -> fallback model=small at=12:01:05Z toolcall_id=tc_42 truncated_after=4 reconnect session=abc123-2 billed_prefixes=[38,14]``` 
sam: hmm. likely provisional credits on attach weren't cleared when fallback happened. we confirm on commit, but fallback appears to leave provisional alive.
jin: also looks like ephemeral session ids for fallback aren't linked to the original provisional. we end up confirming both sessions independently.
dana: to be explicit: router creates provisional ledger entry on initial accept. confirm happens on final commit. fallback path currently spins up a new ephemeral ledger context and confirms there too.
rachel: proposal: emit a telemetry event when fallback occurs (event=fallback_provisional_cancel_candidate) so we can surface in Console and Ops can reconcile spikes.
alex: operational fix: should we cancel the original provisional when fallback happens? is that safe race-wise?
sam: safe if we do it with CAS semantics. change idea: on fallback, call accounting.CancelProvisional(session_id) with a reason tag. If a concurrent commit races, ledger should be able to canonicalize by seqnum.
jin: pseudo patch: ```// router fallback handler
if (fallbackTriggered) {
  accounting.CancelProvisional(originalSession, "fallback_route")
  emitTelemetry("accounting.provisional.cancel", {session: originalSession, reason: "fallback"})
} else {
  accounting.Confirm(originalSession)
}
``` 
morgan: watch out for reconnects that replay prefixes — we need idempotent dedupe on token ranges after cancel.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: accounting/fallback-cancel staging rollout @ 2026-02-19T10:30Z :rocket:
alex: can we feature-flag it? want to slowly ramp.
rachel: yes. feature flag ACCOUNTING_FALLBACK_CANCEL (default=false). Console should show flag toggle + telemetry breakdown.
sam: tests: add an integration that simulates fallback+truncated-toolcall+client-reconnect and assert billed tokens == only-one-path tokens.
jin: add metrics too: accounting.fallback.cancel_attempts, accounting.fallback.cancel_success, accounting.fallback.cancel_conflicts.
dana: note: race case where commit and cancel cross — ledger should return Conflict and we need reconciliation path that emits a refund or alerts.
alex: I'll open a small PR with cancel + telemetry + CAS guard behind the feature flag. assigning reviews to @sam and @jin. Will include the integration test plan.
morgan: :thumbsup: also add a Console trace view: show (primary -> fallback) arrow and provisional vs confirmed badge. that will reduce ops noise.
ops-bot: @oncall notified for staging window.
alex: thanks everyone — filing a support follow-up to the customer saying we have a staged mitigation and we'll reach out after verification. :pray:
